data.revised_prompt: Single original floating AI mascot concept revision named Mofei, centered full-body on a quiet pale blue-white studio background with generous padding. Stylized-concept, Android mascot readability, carefully matching the supplied reference proportions: a compact near-round horizontal oval thin crystal-glass pod, exactly about 1.25:1 wide-to-high, never elongated. Shell material is clear cool-white and icy-blue liquid glass with visible internal deep-blue luminous space, thin rim refraction, exquisite thin blown glass, gentle inner glow, soft caustics, restrained Apple-like liquid glass, never milky plastic, opaque vinyl, chrome, or toy-like. Face is the dominant expressive element: a recessed rounded-square deep-ocean-blue optical visor occupying about 56% of total body width and 48% of total body height, visibly large and readable, integrated into the glass shell, no mouth, no black screen. Eyes: two large widely spaced vertical white-blue glowing eyes with expressive shape and bright soft aura, instantly legible at 38dp. Sides: two small transparent open C-shaped camera-focus brackets tucked close to the left and right shell, not headphones, not gears, not detached far away. Orbit: one very thin blue-white luminous ribbon curves diagonally around the lower shell, subtle but visible. No arms, no legs, no base. State-color potential should be obvious in the visor edge, eyes, inner glow, and orbit: blue idle, cyan focus, violet confirmation, amber reminder, orange deadline, coral red urgent, mint-white completion, but show the central character in a refined ice-blue idle state. Clean studio lighting, soft reflections, elegant minimal composition, one mascot only, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels, no poster layout, no color swatches, no humans, no scenery, no excessive extra characters.
